title: In This Town, Fear Makes a SHIELD

beats.line: In this town, saying I'm scared makes a shield appear.
A little fear makes a dinner plate; a real one makes a wall.
Our coach admitted he feared bees before the big game.
A tiny shield blocked one bee, then blocked the goal.
Now everyone wears helmets and says, 'Nothing scares me.'
Me? I'm the fearless kid who climbs the lookout stairs.
My cousin Lio counts clouds and carries cocoa.
He wears bright red socks, even with snow boots.
He trusts me to keep every promise.
Then a snow squall traps him on the ridge lookout.
The bridge is closed, and the rescue line keeps whipping away.
The chief says, 'We need 40 calm seconds to cross.'
I try, 'I'm scared of the dark.'
A shield the size of a plate appears.
It blocks one snowflake. The wind steals it downhill.
'I'm scared of slipping.' A bigger shield appears.
It shelters one rescuer, but the rope still whips away.
I'm out of small fears. Lio's red socks flash.
'I'm scared I can't keep my promise alone.'
A giant shield rises and blocks the gusts.
The team crosses, reaches Lio, and guides him down.
The shield catches a gust and slides downhill like a sled.
'I'm scared too,' Lio says. A second shield appears.
The town's helmets now come with tiny shields.
